remarks: Immaculate 2 family home that is perfect condition in a great location. 2 bedroom, 1 bath in each unit as well a one car garage and a basement. The second floor has 3 season porch and a walk up attic. The baths and kitchens have been updated. The owner currently lives there and keeps one of the units for company. Great location and walking distance to downtown, Metro North, Gaynor Brenann Golf course and Stamford hospital. Parking in driveway and off street. Pictures will be on Friday August 7 when it goes live. Don't miss this one. Great opportunity for an owner who wants to live in one of the units or an investor.
